subject: Renewal: usage variance, short-term uplift & addendum request
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Eliot Chang <eliot@novaterra.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-27T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal: usage variance, short-term uplift & addendum request

Hi Eliot —

Quick note following the usage telemetry we reviewed yesterday: Novaterra saw a ~2.8x spike in token consumption for the last 30 days driven by two new features (search-summarize and realtime-annotate). We've attached a short report showing per-endpoint token burn and latency variance. 

Recommended next steps to keep you within throughput targets and avoid tail latency during peak hours:
- Temporary 30-day burst (reserved burst credits + priority routing) to cover projected peak (estimated 1.6M tokens/week)
- Addendum to the existing MSA to formalize the burst pricing and extend the renewal date by 60 days to align evaluation with feature rollout
- Solutions-engine review (Grace) to tune batching and KV caching for search-summarize which has the highest per-token latency

I've attached: novaterra_usage_spike_report_Q3.csv and latency_variability_summary.pdf.

Can we set a 30-minute slot tomorrow to walk through the numbers? If procurement wants an addendum draft, Kim and I can push a one-page with pricing examples.

Thanks —
Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

Attachment(s): novaterra_usage_spike_report_Q3.csv, latency_variability_summary.pdf
From: Eliot Chang <eliot@novaterra.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@novaterra.ai>
Date: 2027-10-27T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: usage variance, short-term uplift & addendum request

Jonas —

Thanks for the heads up and for the data. That spike aligns with our internal deploy last week (rolled search-summarize to 20% of users). A couple quick asks:

1) Can you split the burn by feature (search-summarize vs realtime-annotate) so we can map to product telemetry?
2) Procurement looped in — they need the short-form pricing and a one-page economic recap for Legal.
3) Any SLA or latency commitments tied to the burst? We want to avoid surprises.

If you send the addendum and a short ROI table I can get procurement to prioritize.

Eliot
Head of ML Products — Novaterra
eliot@novaterra.ai
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Eliot Chang <eliot@novaterra.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@novaterra.ai>
Date: 2027-10-27T14:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: usage variance, short-term uplift & addendum request

Eliot —

Appreciate the quick reply. Attached is a short breakdown and a draft addendum for Procurement to review: proposed_addendum_draft.docx and economics_calc.xlsx. Highlights below:

- Feature split (last 30 days):
  • search-summarize: 68% of incremental tokens (approx. 1.9M tokens/week)
  • realtime-annotate: 24% of incremental tokens (approx. 0.7M tokens/week)
  • misc/background: 8%

- Proposal (summary):
  • 30-day burst: +250k credits prepaid at a 12% discount vs on-demand (covers projected peak with 10% headroom)
  • Short addendum: formalize burst credits, priority routing, and a one-time SLA credit (if error rate >1.5% during burst window)
  • Renewal shift: push renewal by 60 days to give you time to conclude the pilot and reassess commit level.

- Estimated delta to current monthly spend (baseline): +$18,400 for the burst window; with expected reduction of 14% monthly token cost after Grace's batching/tuning recommendations once applied.

Next steps I propose:
1) Procurement confirms billing/legal details (Kim) — Kim, could you prepare a short commercial summary & DocuSign-ready addendum?
2) Grace to schedule a 45-minute tuning session (can do Tuesday 11/2 or Wednesday 11/3) to implement prefix caching and adjust batch sizes.
3) Eliot to confirm whether Novaterra signs the addendum or prefers a PO-first flow.

Happy to hop on a call today if helpful.

Best,
Jonas

Attachment(s): proposed_addendum_draft.docx, economics_calc.xlsx

Thanks team —

Novaterra will proceed with the DocuSign flow. Legal name: Novaterra, Inc. Billing address: 220 Harbor Lane, Suite 400, San Jose, CA 95110. PO flow not required for this short burst.

A few items to confirm before signing:
- Can Grace confirm that the tuning changes will be applied before the burst window starts (target start: 11/4)? We want to ensure latency variability is reduced so the burst isn't wasted on avoidable retries.
- Data retention: will logs from the burst be retained under the same retention policy in our current agreement? If there are any differences please flag them in the addendum.

If those two items are green, I'll sign the DocuSign this afternoon.

Eliot
